##### PASTE FROM HERE: dev-juniper-synthetic-system-new #####
configure exclusive
# snmp: the description tacctl renders
set snmp description "Core switch"
# system: the statements of the system block of scope 'lab'
set system login message "Authorized use only.\n  *** jsw1.lab.example.net ***\nDisconnect now if you are not authorized.\n  \"quoted\" and a back\\slash"
set system domain-name lab.example.net
set system domain-search lab.example.net
set system time-zone UTC
set system name-server 192.0.2.53
set system ntp server 192.0.2.123 prefer
set system ntp server 192.0.2.123 version 4
set system ntp server 192.0.2.123 key 1
set system ntp boot-server 192.0.2.123
set system ntp source-address 192.0.2.250
set system ntp authentication-key 1 type md5 value ntp-key-0123456789
set system ntp trusted-key 1
show | compare | no-more
commit check
commit confirmed 5 comment "tacctl plan dev-juniper-synthetic-system-new 2026-10-10T14:20Z by alice"
